description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16 - Curfew from 14.00 Hour of 13.05.2022 until 6.00 Hour of 14.05.2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It constitutes a legal/regulatory instrument that imposes restrictions on public movement in specified areas. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding legal requirements (the curfew), which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
